title: Email Relay System
description: A robust and scalable email relay system that handles high-volume email traffic with advanced routing, queuing, and delivery tracking capabilities.

details.overview: A high-performance email relay system designed to handle thousands of emails per minute with intelligent routing and real-time tracking.
keyFeatures: High-volume email processing with optimized queue management
Smart routing based on domain, priority, and delivery requirements
Real-time delivery tracking and status monitoring
Industry-standard security with encryption and authentication
details.challenges: Handling high concurrency while maintaining delivery guarantees and implementing retry logic for failed deliveries.

title: Private LLM File Search
description: An intelligent file search interface powered by Large Language Models, enabling natural language queries across private document collections with advanced context understanding.

details.overview: An AI-powered file search system that allows users to search through private documents using natural language, providing semantic search capabilities with complete privacy.
keyFeatures: Natural language query understanding using LLM technology
Private and secure - all data processing happens locally
Semantic search that finds content based on meaning, not just keywords
Fast indexing and retrieval across large document collections
details.challenges: Balancing search accuracy with privacy requirements and optimizing vector search performance for large document sets.
